description:
Use this when the user asks what a term or ratio on an Indian company's page means or how it is calculated: P/E, ROE, TTM, gross NPA, promoter pledge and the like. It defines terms and never says whether a value is good or bad.

Returns plain-word definitions of the terms, line items and ratios DalalOS reports: what each is, how it is calculated, its unit and which kinds of company it applies to. `term` is one or more keys separated by commas, such as `pe,market_cap`; one unknown key fails the call. `kind` filters to "metric", "line_item", "term" or "section". Without `term` it returns only the list of keys, so pass `term` for the definitions you want.
name: get_glossary
title: Plain-words glossary
